hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.description: We've collected answers to the most popular questions. Can't find yours? Contact our support team!

q1: Who are we and what is this platform?
a1: This is a platform by the Star for Life Ukraine charitable foundation. We help youth develop through education, mentoring, and practice. Here you can participate in tournaments, meet like-minded people, and improve your skills.
a2: No catch 🙂 Participation is free because the platform is supported by partners and donors. Our goal is to provide equal opportunities to everyone.
q3: What kind of tournaments are here?
a3: There are IT tournaments, esports, design, math, creative contests, and other fields. Everyone will find something for themselves.
q4: How do I participate in a tournament?
a4: It's simple: register, choose a tournament in the 'Tournaments' section, and click 'Participate'. Some tournaments require a team — you can create one or join an existing one.
q5: What will I get from participating?
a5: Practical experience, skill development, teamwork, and new connections. There is also a chance to win prizes: gadgets, courses, mentorship, or merch.
q6: How can I change my role on the platform?
a6: Initially, everyone has the 'User' role. To get a different role, submit an application on the 'Role Request' page — we will review it.
q7: What should I do if I have a problem?
a7: If something isn't working (registration, team, etc.), contact support via the 'Contacts' section. We will definitely help.
a8: Most tournaments are aimed at teenagers and students, but conditions may vary. Check the description of the specific tournament.
q9: Can I participate alone (without a team)?
a9: Yes. In many tournaments, you can participate individually or find a team directly on the platform.
q10: Can I participate in several tournaments at the same time?
a10: Yes, as long as the schedules don't overlap and you have enough time to fully participate in all selected competitions.
